rule: File presence and example checks are not independent scientific acceptance.

files.scope: Energy-exact Cayley midpoint map for one quadratic oscillator, not arbitrary Hamiltonian flows.
Symplectic Verlet preserves a modified quadratic energy; physical-energy drift is reported, not set to zero.
Encloses the elliptic Kepler root and planar coordinates; no rational exact representation of general anomalies.
Interval CR3BP vector field, Jacobi value and L4 enclosure; not a certified long-time orbit integrator.
Rational enclosures of accelerations and optional measured finite-time separation; no asymptotic chaos proof.
Momentum is exact; kinetic energy is conserved only for elastic collisions, otherwise heat accounts for loss.
Ideal-gas constitutive model with exact equation of state and interval logarithmic entropy changes.
Exact van der Waals isotherm and analytic critical parameters; phase coexistence needs an additional construction.
Two equilibrium reservoirs, cyclic working fluid, positive absolute temperatures; no universal physical axiom is inferred.
Normalised discrete speed-grid approximation; continuous Maxwell density is not claimed rational/exact.
All configurations on finite 2..4 square tori; Boltzmann weights are enclosed, not irrational exact samples.
Periodic 2D TE Yee discretisation preserves discrete magnetic divergence; this is not a charge-conservation theorem.
Deterministic rational Gauss-Seidel with fixed boundary and measured residual, not a convergence-by-assertion solver.
Exact Snell sine relation and cosine enclosure; arbitrary angles are not rational numbers.
Perfect-conductor guide with conservative 3 < pi < 4 bounds; threshold ambiguity remains explicit.
Finite real symmetric Hamiltonian with Gershgorin bounds; two sites also get individual root enclosures.
Energy enclosures from 3 < pi < 4; pi and general energy levels are not silently made rational.
Rational unnormalised Fock basis with factorial metric; finite truncation cannot satisfy the infinite CCR exactly.
Exact Pauli expectations for pure two-component Q(i) states, normalised by their exact squared norm.
Exterior equatorial timelike geodesic field in G=c=1 units; mass-shell inconsistency is reported, not hidden.
Leading weak-field deflection plus a strong-field turning-point bracket; full strong-field bending is not claimed.
Flat homogeneous Friedmann model with explicit kappa (8*pi*G/3), matter/radiation scaling and root bounds.
Primitive positive integer null vector; include signed atom/isotope/charge rows explicitly. Ambiguous nullspaces are rejected.
Exact stoichiometric extent and nonnegative remainders; reaction feasibility/kinetics are separate obligations.
Atom-balanced complete or prescribed partial CO combustion; ignition and thermodynamic viability are not inferred.
Hess linear combination with exact target verification; input enthalpies remain empirical/model data.
Strictly convex ideal binary isomer mixture; interval closed-form minimizer, not a generic chemical Gibbs solver.
Dimensionless positive activities and explicit pressure/concentration normalisation; equality is exact only for supplied data.
Ideal activity-equals-concentration acid model with a rational hydrogen root bracket and interval pH.
Zero/first/second order models; first-order exponent and half-life are enclosed, not claimed rational constants.
Steady-state enzyme constitutive law with exact monotonic derivative and saturation check.
Arrhenius model on the checked exponential domain, using rational Taylor/remainder enclosures.
Positive dimensionless reaction quotient, explicit electron count and interval natural logarithm.
Exact charge-to-mass conversion conditional on supplied units/constants and unit Faradaic efficiency.
Ideal Butler-Volmer polarisation with interval exponential currents and explicit model parameters.
Cubic and three-index hexagonal reciprocal-metric formulae, returning spacing enclosures.
Hard-sphere ideal-cell geometry with pi/root enclosures; HCP uses the ideal c/a ratio.
Exact Bragg sine, forbidden-reflection detection, and conservative rational half-angle/atan enclosures.
Global affine-gap dynamic programming and deterministic traceback; byte sequences up to 128 bytes.
Smith-Waterman score and endpoint with two rows of memory; linear gaps, no reconstructed traceback.
Finite BWT/FM backward search with explicit sentinel and occurrence counts; bounded pedagogical suffix construction.
Spells one Eulerian traversal using every supplied kmer; repeats can make the original sequence nonunique.
Derives bounded log-odds from supplied counts and pseudocounts; does not invent published PAM/BLOSUM datasets.
Exact average-linkage UPGMA; molecular-clock/ultrametric suitability remains an input-model assumption.
Exact NJ Q-criterion and branch lengths; negative limbs from nonadditive data are reported without clamping.
Fitch minimum unit-change score for one DNA character on a supplied binary tree; ambiguity sets are supported.
Homogeneous JC69 correction with a checked saturation/log domain; empirical model applicability is not proved.
Positive bounded rational nonstandard map; reports continuous-integral drift instead of promising closed orbit preservation.
Rational Beverton-Holt logistic discretisation preserves [0,K]; it is not the exact continuous exponential solution.
Two-allele random-mating model without selection/migration/mutation; exact genotype sum and allele invariance.
Exact squared-distance potential and force on a pair; singular coincident positions are rejected.
Supplied empirical angle boxes and optional nonlocal hard-sphere clash tests; not a proof of protein fold viability.
Closed two-compartment Fick step with exact total amount and nonnegative-concentration guard.
Seven-base Miller-Rabin only for unsigned 64-bit integers; not a Lean primality certificate.
Bounded factor search; unresolved cofactors are explicit, never declared prime.
Nonsingular prime fields, exact group operations; infinity is the empty point.
Extended Euclid with coprimality/domain checks and exact modular verification.
RREF with row pivoting, rectangular matrices and explicit rank/pivot columns.
Fraction-free Bareiss with pivoting and a witness for every exact integer division.
Exact orthogonal unnormalised Q and unit-upper R; irrational unit normalisation is not faked.
Certified-formula rational enclosures for symmetric 2x2 spectra, not a generic exact QR algorithm.
Polynomial Simpson quadrature with an explicit supremum bound on the fourth derivative.
Polynomial continuity plus exact opposite signs brackets a root; no uniqueness assertion.
Central Richardson extrapolation with a safe polynomial fifth-derivative remainder bound.
Graham scan with exact orientation and independent supporting-halfplane checks; collinear sets are explicit.
Incremental Bowyer-Watson with exact in-circle predicates and deterministic cocircular handling.
Exact bounded Voronoi via half-plane clipping; intentionally not an irrational-event Fortune implementation.
Ideal vacuum rocket equation, interval logarithms and mass-consistent staging; external gravity/drag losses omitted.
Lumped one-step frozen-density reentry and Sutton-Graves-type heating enclosure; no flight safety certification.
Rational Cayley rotation update preserves unit norm; it approximates, rather than equals, the angular-rate exponential.
Rational Joseph update with exact positive-definite checks and all-principal-minor PSD process-noise validation.
Exact homogeneous DH transforms parameterised by rational half-angle tangents; angles at the tangent pole need another chart.
Both planar 2R elbow branches and reachability/singularity checks; arbitrary six-axis IK is explicitly unsupported.
Exact six-boundary-condition quintic polynomial and position/velocity/acceleration samples.
Damped Newton for quadratic resistive DC power flow; checks local contraction inequalities, not generic AC convergence.
Balanced RMS positive-sequence fault calculation; breaker sizing is a model calculation, never a trip action.
Single-machine swing model with interval force and energy accounting; no unproved global transient-stability claim.
Exact force-density nodal solve; irrational member lengths produce axial-force enclosures, singular mechanisms fail.
Laminar exact friction or enclosed Colebrook root; empirical transitional regime is explicitly rejected.
Static vertical-wall hydrostatic load only; seepage, foundation, earthquakes and structural safety are separate models.
Quadratic mass/spring oscillator midpoint invariant and finite composition; not arbitrary Hamiltonian flows.
Entropy production hypothesis and two-reservoir Carnot consequence, not a derivation of the physical Second Law.
One-degree-of-freedom quadratic Verlet determinant for nonzero mass and symplectic bilinear form; not exact physical energy.
One spatial direction, c=1, rational representable boosts with explicit gamma normalisation.
Exact norm preservation for rational two-level rotations and proved coarse pi bounds.
Conserved rows may encode isotope/charge inventories; elemental balance alone does not encode nuclear/electron conservation.
Convex quadratic free-energy surrogate only; does not discharge the native ideal-mixture logarithmic minimizer.
Ideal two-species activity/potential equilibrium relation; not a universal chemical constitutive law.
Global optimality and attainability of the mathematical linear-gap Needleman-Wunsch recurrence; affine native refinement remains separate.
Certified nonuniqueness counterexample plus traversal edge count; balanced De Bruijn data do not uniquely recover the original genome.
Two-allele random mating algebra, probability normalisation and allele preservation under declared assumptions.
Real exp/log Taylor tail bounds with explicit order/domain/budget hypotheses; reuses the existing analytic kernel.
Quadratic squared-residual identity and safeguarded rational upper iterates; no division by zero or blanket convergence promise.
3x3 Sylvester exact-division identity; general Bareiss loop is runtime-checked, not formally refined here.
Convexity of the exact supporting-halfplane certificate region; no unproved end-to-end native Graham refinement.
Scalar discrete linear asymptotic stability with |gain|<1; not arbitrary nonlinear-controller Lyapunov synthesis.
Strict positive scalar prior/noise guarantee posterior positivity; zero noise is an explicit counterexample to unconditional strictness.
First-order negative-feedback pole/Nyquist half-plane special case; not the general argument-principle criterion.
Exact bounded polynomial hypothesis fitting with held-out residuals; empirical fit is not a physical law.
Finite cost/toxicity route planning over supplied conserved inventories; conservation alone does not establish chemical viability.
Controlled CLAIM extraction with exact provenance; arbitrary papers and citations stay unverified data, never new axioms.

files.scope: A declared closed oscillator/two-reservoir/isomer model with exact discrete total-energy and amount checks.
SI dimension graph with exact unit scales; additions require equal dimension vectors, multiplicative units only.
Renders bounded closed rational obligations only; the CPU supervisor actually compiles Lean and audits dependencies.
Produces exact counterexamples on a declared finite grid; failure to find one is not a universal proof.
Exact zero witnesses and conservative interval denominator checks; no division is attempted at singular states.
Deterministic finite-grid Gaussian-weight approximation; not a continuous exact Gaussian generator or cryptographic PRNG.
Self-contained hash-addressed article/source/binary-hex/proof container; hashing does not authenticate or prove the artifacts.
Deterministic SVG polyline with exact raw-data hash and explicit 1e-6 display quantisation; no false exact decimal rendering.
Prepares real digest anchor payloads; no transaction is broadcast, fee spent, or fabricated inclusion/timestamp accepted.
Pointwise tensor contractions and Christoffel symbols; curvature requires caller-supplied consistent connection derivatives.
Field arithmetic over Q(i), exact squared norm and zero-denominator rejection.
Bounded quoted CSV with escaped quotes/newlines and optional exact scalar conversion; byte delimiter semantics.
Balanced median-split KD-tree and exact squared-distance pruning; bounded static point sets, deterministic ties.
Sparse exact Q(i) gates up to 32 address bits with active-amplitude quota; H/T and dense 2^32 storage are not falsely supported.
